_comment: It means the phenomenon outright rather than searching for one (design 8.1), which is what
`means_exactly` is for and what `VocabularyCheck` insists on.
**This was missing and nothing caught it**, because the check skips an aspect with one candidate and
the tempest was the only phenomenon anything tagged. Adding a second made it two, the check ran for
the first time, and said the tempest had never been askable either (2026-08-29). It arrived in play
regardless -- `sets` writes the claim and always did -- so what was actually missing is the corpus
being able to say the word reaches it.
